title: cyclophorus subfurfuraceus
intro: Cyclophorus subfurfuraceus, commonly known as the red-bellied Cyclophorus, is a species of air-breathing land snail in the family Cyclophoridae. The health benefits of this plant are not well-documented, however, the Cyclophorus subfurfuraceus snail itself is a key part of the ecosystem in its native environments, helping to regulate plant growth and nutrient cycling. The therapeutic actions of the snail's mucus have been studied for potential uses in wound healing and as a natural antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of the Cyclophorus subfurfuraceus snail's mucus include glycoproteins and glycolipids, which have been shown to have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
